title: Four Rescued From Second Plane Crash Off Oahu: MH-56 Hoist Video
description: The Coast Guard has rescued all four passengers aboard a second single engine aircraft that ran out of fuel and ditched approximately 11 miles west of Oahu, Sunday. A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew located and hoisted all four passengers. They were flown to Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point where they were transferred to emergency medical services. U.S. Coast Guard video
